The End of "Chat" in AI? Meet A2UI, Google's Visual Revolution for 2026!

The video features A2UI (Agent-to-User Interface), Google's open source protocol where the AI agent describes a structured data interface and the application mounts it with its own components. It explains the flow, the principles, the relationship with AG-UI and A2A, the use in old devices and what is scheduled for 2026.

Published in 23 December 2025 · 7 min 17 s

  • Agentic engineering

Open on YouTube

The video and the transcript are in Portuguese. The minutes between brackets lead to the stretch of the video.

From text to interface

Today, the interaction with an AI agent is almost all by text: to mark a commitment, comes one question at a time; to understand data, the AI describes the graph instead of showing it 00:00.

In the video comparison, the minced conversation (which day, what time, how many people) becomes a single request that generates an interactive booking form already filled in. That's the promise of Google's A2UI 00:41.

What is A2UI

A2UI means Agent-to-User Interface. It is a Google open source protocol that allows agents to generate full and interactive interfaces, such as forms and graphics, sending only structured data 01:24.

According to the video, the protocol was announced on December 15, 2025 to standardize the way agents show things. 01:24.

The problem that it solves appears in the network of agents: an agent in our application can call the agent from another company, and this remote agent cannot move directly into the interface of the app 01:45.

A low plant, not code

A2UI does not send code to be executed, which would be risky. Sends a low plant, designed for security and flexibility 02:06.

The video cites Google's blog: "secure as data, but expressive as code". The agent describes the interface, and who builds it is the app itself, with the pieces he already knows 02:28.

The flow has three steps 02:28:

1. The agent sends the plant down on JSON, just a description of the interface 02:50. 2. The application compares the description with its catalog of trusted components 02:50. 3. The application mounts the interface with the native components themselves 03:10.

The principles of the project are three 03:10:

  • security first: traffic data, not executable code 03:10;
  • friendly to LLMs: the structure is simple, easy to generate and send slowly 03:10;
  • platform independent: the same response becomes native interface on the web, Flutter or Angular 03:32.

Where A2UI fits

There are two philosophies. A2UI is native first: the generated interface inherits the style and security of the application 03:54. According to the video, competitors like OpenAI and Anthropic render HTML into an isolated sandbox, and the result seems to be separated from the rest of the app 04:15.

A2UI, AG-UI and A2A do not compete; they are layers 04:15:

  • A2UI defines the interface format 04:36;
  • the AG-UI, of partners like CopilotKit, takes care of transport and communication 04:36;
  • A2A allows agents to talk to each other 04:36.

Besides the chatbots

According to the video, the world produced 62 million tons of electronic garbage in 2022, and many tablets and cell phones go to waste because they no longer run modern software, not because hardware broke. 04:58.

A2UI allows for a slim client architecture: processing is in the cloud, and the old device only renders the interface that AI sends. This can give new life to many devices 05:19.

In the corporate world, Gemini Enterprise already uses A2UI to generate dynamic forms, approval panels and interactive data views 05:40.

What's coming?

According to the video, the project is in public preview. Renters for React, SwiftUI and Jetpack Compose are scheduled for 2026, with version 1.0 stable at the end of the year 06:23.

The project involves internal Google teams and external partners, such as CopilotKit and Flutter team 06:44.

Frequently Asked Questions

Does A2UI send code to the run application?

Nope. Sends a description of the JSON interface, and the application mounts the screen with its own components 02:50.

Does A2UI replace AG-UI or A2A?

Nope. A2UI defines the interface format, AG-UI handles the transport and A2A connects agents to each other 04:36.

About the video

Artificial Intelligence will stop just "talk" and start "showr". Are you ready for the A2UI (Agent-to-User Interface)?

In this video, we dive into Google's new open source protocol that promises to change forever as we interact with AI agents. Forget the infinite shuttle of text messages. With A2UI, AI generates dynamic visual interfaces, forms and buttons in real time, directly on your screen.

What you will learn in this video: The question of security: How Google plans to use "structured data" to avoid code execution risks. The impact on hardware: How ancient devices can gain new life through the cloud. Timetable: When this technology officially reaches the market (2025-2026).

This is the next step in computing and can mean the end of traditional interfaces as we know them.
